title: docs(north-star): align the North Star to ontology-as-software — five edits
body:
Fixes #22172
Clause-②: no

Docs-only. Five maintainer-specified edits to `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` (the maintainer's own text); every other byte of the file is unchanged. `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` is a Tier H governed surface: this PR stays draft and no seat readies, queues or merges it — the maintainer approves and merges by hand.

## The five edits (line numbers at `91854796c`, base `7ef50a4fb`)

| # | Where | Line (before → after) | Edit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 「我们是什么」 line | 3 → 3 | Whole line replaced. 「一个应用开发平台;创业阶段。」 becomes the 本体即软件 definition (对象与字段、关系、动作、权限、流程、Agent 与工具定义 — AI 写、运行时跑、人与 Agent 用、你拥有;创业阶段) followed by the 投影 sentence (视图、仪表盘、应用、翻译是本体的投影). |
| 2 | 「做出来的是什么」 paragraph | 7 → 7 | The capability sentence is untouched. One sentence appended after 「参考实现 hotcrm。」: 「两类用户:今天的业务人员经界面、验收者经控制台;明天的 Agent 经 MCP。路的每一步都要对两类用户成立。」 |
| 3 | 「唯一的度量,那条路」 paragraph | 11 → 11 | One sentence appended after the six steps, after 「跑得通但结果错的是 P2。」: 「四个承诺各由一步兑现:① AI 可写 · ②③ 可执行 · ④ 你拥有 · ⑤ Agent 可操作 · ⑥ 是闭环。」 |
| 4 | Step ④ 「发布并装进一个环境」 list | new line 96 (after old line 95) | One row appended in the file's own row grammar `轴 · 功能点(业务语言) · 清单区 · 项 id`: `- devpath · 你拥有:定义在你的仓库里可 diff,整个本体可导出、可在没有我们的情况下自托管跑起来 · platform-core + cli · ontology-export-roundtrip, artifact-reproducible-build, standalone-boot-no-cloud(待清单扫描建项)` |
| 5 | 优先级 item 4 | 116 → 117 | Two phrase swaps only: 「元数据既要 AI 能写」 → 「本体既要 AI 能写」 and 「也要 AI 能用」 → 「也要人与 Agent 能用——Agent 越权时被权限挡住并留痕」. The rest of the item is byte-identical. |

`git diff -U0 7ef50a4fb` shows exactly five hunks (`@@ -3 +3 @@`, `@@ -7 +7 @@`, `@@ -11 +11 @@`, `@@ -95,0 +96 @@`, `@@ -116 +117 @@`). `git diff --stat` is one file, +5 / -4, and `--ignore-all-space --stat` reads the same, so no whitespace or line-ending change rides along; the file keeps its trailing newline and carries no CR bytes.

Premise check: every anchor the card quotes was present verbatim on `origin/main` at `7ef50a4fb` (the file's last landing is still `78e3e3a62`, no same-day churn), so there is no quote difference to report.

## Deliberately NOT changed (the maintainer's four)

- No global 元数据 → 本体 replacement: the word 元数据 still stands everywhere else (「给谁」, 「什么算做好」, 「唯一的度量」, the step rows, 「阶段姿态」).
- No 「核心优先于投影」 ordering rule added.
- The 「做出来的是什么」 capability list is neither reordered nor trimmed.
- 「现在不做」, 「阶段姿态」, 「仪器为车队服务」 and 「账本」 are untouched.

Control bytes: `grep -naP` over the control-character class on the file is clean (exit 1, no match).

Gates: derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` from the real changeset against merge base `7ef50a4fb` (13 commands, byte-identical to the `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` path form), run on HEAD `91854796c`, each exit code captured before any pipe:

Drift from the dispatch's gate snapshot (taken earlier the same day): the derived list carries `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` where the snapshot named `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-authoring`, and it adds `pnpm check:watch-hint-literal`; both derived commands were run. `package.json` has no `check:*` script named `north-star`.

NOT MEASURED locally, by design (CI owns them): the whole-tree `pnpm lint`, the type-check lanes and the Test Core shards the derivation lists as CI-only. This diff touches no package source, so the dependency closure of affected packages is empty and no package `build`, `test` or `typecheck` is owed by the diff itself; the one build run here (`@objectstack/formula` + `@objectstack/lint`, under the shared verify lock) was a declared prerequisite of the doc-formula gate, not a consequence of the change.

## Acceptance notes

- The three checklist ids in the new row (`ontology-export-roundtrip`, `artifact-reproducible-build`, `standalone-boot-no-cloud`) do not exist yet in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/`. The row marks them 「待清单扫描建项」 per the maintainer's text, while line 13 of the file spells the convention for unwritten items as 「清单项待写」. Observation only, maintainer wording kept verbatim; no script under `scripts/` reads the row ids, so no gate is affected. Carrier: the checklist-author sweep that creates the three items. Noted, not filed.
- The dispatch's gate snapshot drifted within the day (see Verification). Recorded for the PM; no action in this PR.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么

只改 `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`,五处,每处都是你在卡上给的原文:① 「我们是什么」整行换成「本体即软件」的定义与投影句;② 「做出来的是什么」段末追加「两类用户」一句,能力清单一字不动;③ 「唯一的度量」段末追加「四个承诺各由一步兑现」一句;④ 第 ④ 步清单末尾加一行「你拥有」(devpath · platform-core + cli,三个待建清单项);⑤ 优先级第 4 条两处措辞:「元数据既要 AI 能写」→「本体既要 AI 能写」,「也要 AI 能用」→「也要人与 Agent 能用——Agent 越权时被权限挡住并留痕」。其余字节不动;你点名不改的四项(不全文替换 元数据→本体、不加「核心优先于投影」、能力清单不重排不删、「现在不做」「阶段姿态」「仪器为车队服务」「账本」)都没碰。

### 为什么改

北极星从「应用开发平台」对齐到「本体即软件」:把产品定义、两类用户、四个承诺与路的六步一一对应写进去,并把「你拥有」(可 diff、可导出、可自托管)列为路上的一个功能点。这是卡 #22172 的全部内容,不多不少。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)

纯文档,无代码、无发布面、无 changeset(`skip-changeset`)。风险在措辞:第 ④ 步新行的三个清单项 id 还不存在,行尾已标「待清单扫描建项」;文件第 13 行对未写项的约定拼法是「清单项待写」,这里按你的原文保留,没有门禁读这些 id。回滚 = revert 这一个 commit,无副作用。
